scope: Actual It Could Be Worse and It’s Worse actions during drain and battle losses. Six cancel outcomes with X=0,1,5 compare costs, remaining damage and both Interrupts Lost. Two battle-after-loss observations compare the initial increase after one/two paid Force and record the repeated-copy disagreement. One repeated drain-cancellation outcome agrees with noncumulative modifier behavior. No GEMP production source changes.
references: Card1_252.java both printed functions and before/after action handlers
Card1_090.java It Could Be Worse, cost range 1..available Force
CancelCardBeingPlayedEffect.java removes the canceled card immediately; PlayInterruptAction.java checks its current zone before final disposal
IncreaseForceLossEffect.java changes existing drain, general Force loss or battle damage; no new loss event
AR printed p147 It’s Worse: modifier of original loss; optional responses to original Force drain already passed
AR printed pp28–29 Modifiers/Cumulatively: copies do not cumulatively modify the same base value without explicit permission
AR printed p83 Used Interrupts canceled go to Lost
differences: GEMP BattleDamageModifier hardcodes cumulative=true. Second copies after the same battle Force loss add another +1 in both observations. Native follows AR pp28–29/147: additional copies remain playable but cannot increase that same base damage again. First applied positive modifier persists; zero-cost cancellation adds no modifier. Tests retain actual GEMP values and explicitly assert this divergence; full legal-choice/outcome parity is not claimed.
limits: Current hand-play, ordinary canceled-card Lost disposition and existing ground/battle loss contexts only. Generic targeting/cancellation prevention, alternate disposal/replacement effects, individual Force-use windows and full loss arithmetic with continuous modifiers remain unfinished. Native-only tests use controlled interventions for cancellation/prevention, nested independent loss, returned canceled target and reversed battle-damage ownership. They do not claim implementation of those other cards. Failed-duel amount remains guarded. Full native card/deck admission and match service/UI are still incomplete.
